reason: B offers the more physically grounded, specific, and falsifiable mechanism: suppressing fast-growing nonprotective oxides while grain-boundary transport accelerates establishment of a Cr/Al-rich barrier, tested against oxidation kinetics and scale structure over defined conditions. Although a factorial design is needed to separate composition from grain-size effects—and grain stability at 1100 °C must be verified—it extends prior findings, whereas A relies on a vague and questionable configurational-entropy/oxide-synergy argument with a poorly composition-matched baseline.
